name: All Access
description: ALL ACCESS, SHOWTIME Sports takes you beyond the boxing ring.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Premiere episode of the new series from Emmy® Award-winning SHOWTIME Sports. In anticipation of rising superstar Victor Ortiz' June 23 bout against Josesito Lopez, ALL ACCESS provides viewers with an intimate portrait of Ortiz. Although not limited to the fight game, initial series subjects will take viewers behind the curtain and inside the provocative and often edgy world of boxing and mixed martial arts with virtually unrestricted license as only SHOWTIME can.

videos.title: Vazquez vs. Marquez III Pt 2
videos.overview: This week we go in depth with Israel Vazquez as he trains for his third and deciding bout with Rafael Marquez. We talk to his manager Frank Espinoza and trainer Rudy Perez about his style and confidence. After training, Vazquez goes for a physical to examine his injuries from his last two fights with Marquez. Candidly, Vazquez tells us why he must win.

videos.title: Vazaquez vs Marquez III Part 3
videos.overview: From Mexico City we take an intimate look at Rafael Marquez as he trains for his final fight against Israel Vazques. He starts his day before sunrise and ends with a family meal. He talks about the fight and his desire to win. He goes through a grueling training routine at the Zaragoza gym with trainer Nacho Beristain.

videos.title: Vazquez vs Marquez III Part 4
videos.overview: In this final installment of All Access we talk to both Israel Vazquez and Rafael Marquez about their last two fights. In their own words they describe the fights and their expectations for the outcome of this third and final battle.
